response.justification: Bogdan is an experienced, versatile senior/staff engineer with a strong software-craftsmanship background and rare, directly relevant IDE experience (C/C++ components for NI LabWindows/CVI) plus demonstrable tooling and open-source library work. However, the role's core requirements — deep JVM expertise, strong Java and Kotlin, and solid Spring/enterprise-framework experience — are essentially absent. Java appears only as a secondary mention on projects from 2016-2018, Kotlin and Spring/Quarkus/Hibernate do not appear at all, and the last decade of work is predominantly TypeScript/Node.js and DLang. The gap on the primary technical stack is too large for a mid-senior IC expected to own enterprise-framework subsystems from day one.
strengths: Prior IDE product experience (NI LabWindows/CVI) and strong developer-tooling/OSS track record
15+ years across web, mobile, desktop, embedded; proven at low-latency, high-scale systems
Strong testing/craftsmanship culture (TDD, CI/CD, test runners, workshops, public speaking)
concerns: No demonstrated Kotlin or Spring/Quarkus/Hibernate experience; Java only peripheral and dated
Little evidence of deep JVM internals, build tooling, or app-server integration work
Recent 8+ years focused on TypeScript/Node.js product work, not language tooling on the JVM
